Why Desert Darlings

Bred for health and temperament, not just looks

Every litter is planned around genetics, care, and a real home environment. Here's what that means for you.

TICA Registered Cattery

Our cattery and every litter are TICA registered, so lineage and pedigree are documented and verifiable.

Genetic Health Testing

Breeding cats undergo over 40 genetic health tests before any litter is planned.

Raised With Family & Pets

Kittens grow up underfoot in our home, around people, kids, and other pets, so they're socialized, not just healthy.

Litter-Trained Before Pickup

Every kitten is litter-trained and comfortable with day-to-day home routines before it goes home with you.

2-Year Health Guarantee & Free Insurance

Every kitten comes with a 2-year genetic health guarantee, free pet insurance, current vaccinations, and deworming records.

Support After Adoption

Questions about food, litter, vet visits, or behavior? We stay reachable long after you take your kitten home.

Our Breed

Gentle, affectionate Ragdoll kittens

Every litter is raised the same way, with health testing, TICA registration, and plenty of hands-on attention before it's time to go home.

Ragdoll Kittens

Gentle, affectionate, and famously relaxed, Ragdolls are known for going limp when picked up and following their people from room to room.

  • Colors: Color Point (seal, blue, chocolate, lilac, red), Bicolor, Lynx
  • Rare colors: Sepia, Lilac, Cinnamon, Solids
  • Large, semi-longhair breed with a soft, plush coat

Questions

Frequently asked questions

What determines the price of a Desert Darlings kitten?

Pricing reflects genetic health testing on breeding cats (40+ health markers), TICA registration, veterinary care, high-quality nutrition, and the months of hands-on raising each litter receives before going home.

What does the reservation process look like?

Request pricing, then place a 50% non-refundable deposit to reserve a specific kitten or a spot in an upcoming litter. You'll receive updates and photos until your kitten is ready at 10–12 weeks, vaccinated and vet-checked.

Is the deposit refundable?

The deposit is non-refundable, as it reserves a kitten exclusively for you and takes that kitten off the availability list. The remaining balance is due at pickup.

What health guarantees come with each kitten?

Every kitten is tested for hereditary health conditions, comes with a 2-year genetic health guarantee and free pet insurance, and is vaccinated and dewormed prior to adoption, with records provided.

Limited Litters Each Year
